title: Mixed Event — The Tomorrow We Hope For — Episode6 Happy New Year!

meta.Event Outline: When Haruka stops by the shrine along her usual running route, she sees the shrine maiden who was there for her in her time of need collapse. In order to repay her for her kindness, Haruka decides to help out at the shrine in her stead.

rows.Line: New Year's Eve - 11:30 pm
Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We're here♪
Whoa, this place is packed!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah! Wow☆
I just caught a glimpse of a bunch of food stalls too!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Rin, what are you doing?!
You can't just pop out like that!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Ugh. They won't see me as long as I'm in her pocket!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, Rin. We'll try to find a place where you can have a better look, so just bear with us for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hm?
Is something bothering you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, uh... Shizuku sent me a message saying that she's been volunteering as a shrine maiden here sometime tonight...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
S-She is?
Shizuku as a shrine maiden?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, won't this place get swarmed if people find out about that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, she said she has a disguise ready to cover her face. I'm just worried about what would happen if she sees me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: Hm? I could've sworn that I heard Shii's voice just now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That voice...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Back in line, you guys. Try to blend in...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel like you should at least tell her you're here. Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hello, Hoshino, Tenma.
Oh, Hinomori, Mochizuki, you're here as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all for visiting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No way!
You're here too, Haruka?! You look adorable as a shrine maiden!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree! It suits you so well...!
You look like a real shrine maiden...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
Some things came up and we decided to lend this shrine a hand as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I had no idea...!
Does that mean Minori and Momoi are here too?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. They should be at reception right now. If you have some time to spare, why not go take a peek?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Airi's here too?!
We've gotta see this...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. You really can't get enough of her, can you, Saki? I mean, you just got her autograph the other day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, but I'm a huge fan!
I watched the variety shows she was on all the time when I was in the hospital♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's great to hear.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why not go let them know that you're here? I'm sure they'll be happy to see some familiar faces. Also, Hinomori, Shizuku should be just over there.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Also, it's dark out, so please watch your step.
Reception

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's see... Hey, there's Airi!
She's the one selling charms and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm gonna go buy one!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, Saki, don't run like that...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, a ceremonial arrow, a traffic-safety charm and a talisman. I believe that's everything...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, that was so fast...!
She's a total pro!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like she knows exactly where everything is.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, next up... Oh?
Is that you, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yes!
You remember who I am, Airi?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Of course!
How can I forget?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh wow...! I don't know what to say...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You went through the trouble of lining up, Saki. Why don't you get something?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
I'll get... A charm for good health!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You got it.
They're pink and really cute, just like you, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And here you are!
One charm for good health filled with some of Airi Momoi's love♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really?! Thank you so much!
You're the best, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're welcome. I'd love to stay and chat, but we're pretty busy tonight.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you, Momoi.
I hope you'll keep an eye on my sister during the new year as well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
Speaking of which, have you seen Shizuku yet? I'm sure she'll be happy to see you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh... Well, I don't want to be a bother... But I guess I should if you insist...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Good!
And good luck with your band!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We're back!
Airi's seriously the best! I like her even more now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. Good for you, Saki.
We still have some time, so why don't we draw some fortunes...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Good idea.
It's probably gonna be really crowded later if we put it off.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay...!!
Let's head over!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't think people usually get this worked up over Omikuji.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's like she's going into battle or something...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It should be... Oh, found it!
Look, Hanasato's behind that counter.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Really?
Why don't we do our drawings there?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Oh, I wanna see what I get!
Can you draw mine for me, Hona?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<I'd like to see as well!
How about you, KAITO?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I am a little curious...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wait, won't it be weird if you drew fortunes for six extra people?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Oh, he's right. Why don't we just have one collective drawing instead? How would you feel about that, Honami?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A-Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, you can count on me!
I promise to draw something good this time...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-I'm worried about Honami...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So am I...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Let's see...! #39!
Here's your fortune. Next please.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good evening, Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Honami! What a nice coincidence!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, here's the Omikuji tube!
I recommend shaking it a few times before drawing anything out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay... Here goes nothing!
se_event_prayer_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (H-Honami has such a stern look on her face! I don't think I've seen anyone take this so seriously...! Does she have a really big wish or something...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll take this one! Please!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, lemme see!
Uh... #66! That should be right over here!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A-Another “great curse”!! How?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A... A “great curse”?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I knew this would happen...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, she's been jinxing it left and right...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Wh-What do I do...?!
I need to cheer Honami up somehow...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Honami!
You'll be rewarded as long as you keep trying your best! I'm sure of it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: H-Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-How about you do another drawing...?! You'd still, unfortunately, have to pay for it, but I'm sure it'll be better than your last one...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's a small price to pay...
Okay, #34!
se_event_prayer_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, here you are!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A-Another “curse”...!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, that's a good thing! That means you're improving! I'm sure you'll do even better if you keep trying!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, you're absolutely right! Again...!
se_event_prayer_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't think that's how these fortunes work...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I doubt it too...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I did it...! I got a “good blessing”!
Hanasato, I finally got one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
C-Congratulations!!
I knew you'd succeed as long as you kept trying!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Hona's happy, so it's all good♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you're right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting!
I finally drew a “good blessing”!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. I can see that.
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The bell...
It's already past midnight.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You're right.
When did that happen...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry...
We missed our chance because I got so caught up in drawing a good fortune...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No problemo!
We can just do it now. Ready...?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now then, shall we go make our wishes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm gonna wish for a ton of stuff this year!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe...
